scope: 21 Galaxy at War character-scale weapon claims only. No rolling authority mutation. No production mutation authorization.

schemaDelta.principle: Galaxy at War extends the normalized authority only where a printed rule cannot be represented by Core + KOTOR. These are authority-schema edits, not production migrations.

requiredEdits.change: Expand canonicalStats.attackProfiles so each profile can carry schemaFamily, damage, damageType, stun, rateOfFire, range, qualities, attackResolution, area, and resourceConsumption.
why: ICWS changes from rifle to heavy-weapon proficiency in anti-armor mode.
ICWS standard mode has stun while sniper/anti-armor profiles do not.
Ascension and heavy-variable weapons have non-damaging utility profiles.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append attackProfiles to every Core/KOTOR record. For ordinary single-profile weapons create one primary profile mirroring the existing canonicalStats fields. Do not invent alternate profiles.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.modeProfiles[] with id, label, switchAction, attackProfileId, and resourceConsumption.
why: Variable blaster rifles change damage and ammunition consumption as a swift action.
ICWS changes configurations as a standard action.
Ascension guns switch between blaster and tether modes.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Core/KOTOR records with no mode-specific mechanics receive modeProfiles: []. Existing explicit alternate modes may be linked to their primary profile without changing published facts.

requiredEdits.change: Allow canonicalStats.resource.consumption plus per-profile resourceConsumption, including multipliers.
why: Variable rifle uses 1x/5x/10x shots; heavy variable uses 1x/10x/20x.
ICWS anti-armor ammunition and ascension syntherope are separate resources.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append resource.consumption: null when no special consumption rule exists. Preserve existing capacities/reload data.

requiredEdits.change: Add stun.damageMode = same-as-active-profile and permit attackProfiles[].stun to override record-level stun.
why: Variable damage weapons with a stun setting must derive stun damage from the selected damage profile.
ICWS has stun in blaster mode but not in sniper or anti-armor modes.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Do not replace explicit printed stun dice. Core/KOTOR ordinary stun settings remain same-as-base or explicit as already certified.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.range.allowedBands and attackProfiles[].range.allowedBands. Keep qualities booleans separate.
why: Galaxy at War footnote 1 defines Inaccurate as unable to fire at Medium or Long range, unlike the Core/KOTOR long-range-only definition.
Arc removes Point-Blank range.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Core ordinary ranged profiles get all four bands. KOTOR Inaccurate entries get [pointBlank, short, medium]. Galaxy at War Inaccurate entries get [pointBlank, short]. Do not silently overwrite one source definition with another.

requiredEdits.change: Add qualityParameters for source-specific mechanical parameters while retaining qualities.accurate/inaccurate/arc booleans.
why: The same named quality can have different printed range consequences across books.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append qualityParameters with null entries unless the source establishes a parameter. KOTOR Inaccurate should explicitly preserve long-only exclusion.

why: Radiation grenade attacks Fortitude instead of Reflex.
Targeting laser ignores armor bonuses to Reflex.
Area attacks may deal half damage on a miss.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Normal Core/KOTOR weapon profiles use standard Reflex resolution with no ignored components; only source exceptions use override.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].area {enabled, shape, radiusSquares, lengthSquares, widthAtEndSquares, widthSquares, heightSquares, notes}.
why: Flame cannon is a 12-square cone, 8 squares wide at terminus.
Radiation/smoke grenades use 2-square bursts.
ICWS anti-armor uses 3-square burst.
Rotary blaster cannon changes autofire area when braced.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append area.enabled=false for non-area profiles. Backfill previously certified Core/KOTOR area weapons only from their already-certified source facts.

requiredEdits.change: Add conditionalDamageProfiles[] and add baseDamage mode conditional.
why: Scatter gun damage changes by range.
Darkstick damage changes when two or more are held in one hand.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append conditionalDamageProfiles: [] to Core/KOTOR unless a previously certified source rule already requires conditional damage.

requiredEdits.change: Allow attackProfiles[].kind values attack, utility, and special, and permit damage.mode=none with a source table literal such as Special.
why: Ascension mode and targeting laser are weapon-operated profiles that do not deal ordinary weapon damage.
Tactical tractor beam has source-specific special handling.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Ordinary profiles remain kind=attack. Do not create utility profiles without source authority.
